title: New hair: pick your Nyborg's style
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: Nyborgs have new fuzzy hair, and you pick the style: Shaggy mop (the default), Pom cloud, Muppet fringe, Tousled crest, or Classic yarn for anyone who misses the strands. Every Nyborg wears its own style in the Customizer, in races and in tank matches.

Your saved Nyborgs moved to the Shaggy mop automatically, with a backup of the old library kept in your browser first. Shared links carry the style, and every older link still shows the same yarn look.
